parameters.query:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    now() AS run_at,
    date_trunc('day', now()) AS day_start,
    now() - interval '24 hours' AS since_24h,
    now() - interval '6 hours' AS stuck_before
),
participant_entry_counts AS (
  SELECT
    te.person_id,
    count(*) AS entry_count,
    min(te.created_at) AS first_entry_at
  FROM tracker_entries te
  WHERE te.person_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY te.person_id
),
audience_summary AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT count(*) FROM participant_entry_counts) AS unique_participants,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM participant_entry_counts, params WHERE first_entry_at >= params.day_start) AS new_participants_today,
    (
      SELECT jsonb_build_object(
        'participant',
        coalesce(nullif(trim(p.first_name), ''), pec.person_id::text),
        'person_id',
        pec.person_id::text,
        'entries',
        pec.entry_count
      )
      FROM participant_entry_counts pec
      LEFT JOIN persons p ON p.person_id = pec.person_id
      ORDER BY pec.entry_count DESC, pec.first_entry_at ASC
      LIMIT 1
    ) AS most_active_participant,
    (SELECT round(avg(entry_count)::numeric, 1) FROM participant_entry_counts) AS avg_entries_per_participant
),
data_intake AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT count(*) FROM tracker_entries) AS tracker_entries_total,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM tracker_entries, params WHERE tracker_entries.created_at >= params.day_start) AS tracker_entries_today,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM tracker_entries, params WHERE tracker_entries.created_at >= params.since_24h) AS tracker_entries_last_24h,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM observations) AS observations_total,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM observations, params WHERE observations.created_at >= params.day_start) AS observations_today,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM research_signal_candidates) AS signal_candidates_total,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM research_signal_candidates, params WHERE research_signal_candidates.created_at >= params.day_start) AS signal_candidates_today
),
interview_funnel AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT count(*) FROM parent_interviews) AS parent_interviews_total,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM parent_interviews WHERE status = 'started') AS started,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM parent_interviews WHERE status = 'in_progress') AS in_progress,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM parent_interviews WHERE status = 'completed') AS completed,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM parent_interviews WHERE status = 'abandoned') AS abandoned
),
stage_counts AS (
  SELECT jsonb_object_agg(stage_name, stage_count ORDER BY stage_order) AS active_conversations_by_stage
  FROM (
    SELECT
      v.stage_order,
      v.stage_name,
      count(c.conversation_id) AS stage_count
    FROM (VALUES
      (1,'new'),
      (2,'waiting_q1'),
      (3,'waiting_q2'),
      (4,'waiting_q3'),
      (5,'waiting_q4'),
      (6,'analysis'),
      (7,'completed')
    ) AS v(stage_order, stage_name)
    LEFT JOIN conversations c ON c.current_stage = v.stage_name AND c.status = 'active'
    GROUP BY v.stage_order, v.stage_name
  ) s
),
observation_quality AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT count(*) FROM observations) AS observations_total,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM research_signal_candidates) AS signal_candidates_total,
    CASE
      WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM observations) = 0 THEN 0
      ELSE round(((SELECT count(*) FROM research_signal_candidates)::numeric / (SELECT count(*) FROM observations)::numeric) * 100, 1)
    END AS observation_signal_conversion_pct
),
top_today AS (
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('signal_name', signal_name, 'count', signal_count) ORDER BY signal_count DESC), '[]'::jsonb) AS top_signal_name_today
  FROM (
    SELECT coalesce(signal_name, 'unknown') AS signal_name, count(*) AS signal_count
    FROM research_signal_candidates, params
    WHERE research_signal_candidates.created_at >= params.day_start
    GROUP BY coalesce(signal_name, 'unknown')
    ORDER BY signal_count DESC
    LIMIT 5
  ) x
),
top_all AS (
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('signal_name', signal_name, 'count', signal_count) ORDER BY signal_count DESC), '[]'::jsonb) AS top_signal_name_all_time
  FROM (
    SELECT coalesce(signal_name, 'unknown') AS signal_name, count(*) AS signal_count
    FROM research_signal_candidates
    GROUP BY coalesce(signal_name, 'unknown')
    ORDER BY signal_count DESC
    LIMIT 5
  ) x
),
status_counts AS (
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(status_name, status_count), '{}'::jsonb) AS candidate_status_counts
  FROM (
    SELECT coalesce(status, 'unknown') AS status_name, count(*) AS status_count
    FROM research_signal_candidates
    GROUP BY coalesce(status, 'unknown')
  ) x
),
signal_summary AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT top_signal_name_today FROM top_today) AS top_signal_name_today,
    (SELECT top_signal_name_all_time FROM top_all) AS top_signal_name_all_time,
    (SELECT round(avg(confidence)::numeric, 3) FROM research_signal_candidates WHERE confidence IS NOT NULL) AS average_confidence,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM research_signal_candidates WHERE confidence IS NOT NULL AND confidence < 0.5) AS low_confidence_count,
    (SELECT candidate_status_counts FROM status_counts) AS candidate_status_counts
),
top_contributors AS (
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'participant',
    participant,
    'person_id',
    person_id,
    'count',
    entry_count
  ) ORDER BY entry_count DESC), '[]'::jsonb) AS contributors
  FROM (
    SELECT
      coalesce(nullif(trim(p.first_name), ''), pec.person_id::text) AS participant,
      pec.person_id::text AS person_id,
      pec.entry_count
    FROM participant_entry_counts pec
    LEFT JOIN persons p ON p.person_id = pec.person_id
    ORDER BY pec.entry_count DESC, pec.first_entry_at ASC
    LIMIT 5
  ) x
),
participant_distribution AS (
  SELECT
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE entry_count = 1) AS participants_with_1_entry,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE entry_count BETWEEN 2 AND 5) AS participants_with_2_5_entries,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE entry_count > 5) AS participants_with_gt_5_entries
  FROM participant_entry_counts
),
bottlenecks AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT count(*) FROM observations o LEFT JOIN research_signal_candidates r ON r.observation_id = o.observation_id WHERE r.candidate_id IS NULL) AS observations_without_signal_candidates,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM research_signal_candidates WHERE observation_id IS NULL) AS signal_candidates_without_observation_id,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM conversations, params WHERE status = 'active' AND current_stage IN ('new','waiting_q1','waiting_q2','waiting_q3','waiting_q4','analysis') AND coalesce(stage_updated_at, started_at) < params.stuck_before) AS conversations_stuck_over_6h,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM parent_interviews pi WHERE pi.status IN ('started','in_progress') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM interview_responses ir WHERE ir.interview_id = pi.interview_id)) AS interviews_started_no_responses,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM conversation_events, params WHERE conversation_events.created_at >= params.day_start AND (event_type = 'error' OR event_payload::text ILIKE '%error%')) AS errors_today
),
repeated_themes AS (
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('theme', signal_name, 'count', signal_count) ORDER BY signal_count DESC), '[]'::jsonb) AS themes
  FROM (
    SELECT coalesce(signal_name, 'unknown') AS signal_name, count(*) AS signal_count
    FROM research_signal_candidates, params
    WHERE research_signal_candidates.created_at >= params.since_24h
    GROUP BY coalesce(signal_name, 'unknown')
    HAVING count(*) > 1
    ORDER BY signal_count DESC
    LIMIT 5
  ) x
),
emerging_behaviors AS (
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('behavior', signal_name, 'count', signal_count) ORDER BY signal_count DESC), '[]'::jsonb) AS behaviors
  FROM (
    SELECT coalesce(signal_name, 'unknown') AS signal_name, count(*) AS signal_count
    FROM research_signal_candidates, params
    WHERE research_signal_candidates.created_at >= params.since_24h
    GROUP BY coalesce(signal_name, 'unknown')
    HAVING count(*) > 1
    ORDER BY signal_count DESC
    LIMIT 5
  ) x
),
reflection_coach_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    false AS tracked,
    NULL::integer AS confirmations_sent,
    NULL::integer AS questions_sent,
    NULL::integer AS missions_sent,
    NULL::integer AS deep_reflections_sent
)
SELECT
  params.run_at,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'unique_participants', audience_summary.unique_participants,
    'new_participants_today', audience_summary.new_participants_today,
    'most_active_participant', audience_summary.most_active_participant,
    'avg_entries_per_participant', audience_summary.avg_entries_per_participant
  ) AS audience_summary,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'tracker_entries_total', data_intake.tracker_entries_total,
    'tracker_entries_today', data_intake.tracker_entries_today,
    'tracker_entries_last_24h', data_intake.tracker_entries_last_24h,
    'observations_total', data_intake.observations_total,
    'observations_today', data_intake.observations_today,
    'signal_candidates_total', data_intake.signal_candidates_total,
    'signal_candidates_today', data_intake.signal_candidates_today
  ) AS data_intake,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'parent_interviews_total', interview_funnel.parent_interviews_total,
    'started', interview_funnel.started,
    'in_progress', interview_funnel.in_progress,
    'completed', interview_funnel.completed,
    'abandoned', interview_funnel.abandoned,
    'active_conversations_by_stage', stage_counts.active_conversations_by_stage
  ) AS interview_funnel,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'observations_total', observation_quality.observations_total,
    'signal_candidates_total', observation_quality.signal_candidates_total,
    'observation_signal_conversion_pct', observation_quality.observation_signal_conversion_pct
  ) AS observation_quality,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'top_signal_name_today', signal_summary.top_signal_name_today,
    'top_signal_name_all_time', signal_summary.top_signal_name_all_time,
    'average_confidence', signal_summary.average_confidence,
    'low_confidence_count', signal_summary.low_confidence_count,
    'candidate_status_counts', signal_summary.candidate_status_counts
  ) AS signal_summary,
  top_contributors.contributors AS top_contributors,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'participants_with_1_entry', participant_distribution.participants_with_1_entry,
    'participants_with_2_5_entries', participant_distribution.participants_with_2_5_entries,
    'participants_with_gt_5_entries', participant_distribution.participants_with_gt_5_entries
  ) AS participant_distribution,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'observations_without_signal_candidates', bottlenecks.observations_without_signal_candidates,
    'signal_candidates_without_observation_id', bottlenecks.signal_candidates_without_observation_id,
    'conversations_stuck_over_6h', bottlenecks.conversations_stuck_over_6h,
    'interviews_started_no_responses', bottlenecks.interviews_started_no_responses,
    'errors_today', bottlenecks.errors_today
  ) AS bottlenecks,
  emerging_behaviors.behaviors AS emerging_behaviors,
  repeated_themes.themes AS repeated_themes,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'tracked', reflection_coach_metrics.tracked,
    'confirmations_sent', reflection_coach_metrics.confirmations_sent,
    'questions_sent', reflection_coach_metrics.questions_sent,
    'missions_sent', reflection_coach_metrics.missions_sent,
    'deep_reflections_sent', reflection_coach_metrics.deep_reflections_sent
  ) AS reflection_coach_metrics
FROM params
CROSS JOIN audience_summary
CROSS JOIN data_intake
CROSS JOIN interview_funnel
CROSS JOIN stage_counts
CROSS JOIN observation_quality
CROSS JOIN signal_summary
CROSS JOIN top_contributors
CROSS JOIN participant_distribution
CROSS JOIN bottlenecks
CROSS JOIN emerging_behaviors
CROSS JOIN repeated_themes
CROSS JOIN reflection_coach_metrics;
